rule_title: TTP 1021.006 - WS-Management Listener Enumeration via EID 4656
description: Detects handle requests against the WS-Management Listener object, indicating enumeration or access of WinRM listener configuration. AccessMask 0x7 (Read/Write/Execute) with a unique LogonId per request and no HandleId (0x0) is the fingerprint of automated WinRM listener enumeration, consistent with tools like CrackMapExec or custom WinRM implants. Observed: OFFSEC\admmig enumerating WinRM listeners across win10-02, fs03vuln, and rootdc1 within 43 seconds.
